about: The controls help (control.<id>.keys, control.<id>.text); their order is game data (content/game-v1/game/controls.json).

strings.control.walk.keys: W A S D or the arrow keys
strings.control.gather.text: Collect wood from a tree or fruit from a bush (aim the dot in the middle of the screen at it).
strings.control.place.text: Place the item you are holding.
strings.control.eat.keys: Right mouse button with food in your hand, or {key:talk} at water
strings.control.eat.text: Eat the food you hold or drink the bottle. At a river, a lake or a well, {key:talk} drinks from your hand.
strings.control.sprint.text: Run faster while you have stamina.
strings.control.hotbar.text: Choose an item in the bar at the bottom.
strings.control.talk.text: Talk to someone. {key:type} lets you type, {key:listen} lets you speak.
strings.control.craft.text: Make things from what you carry.
strings.control.journal.text: Your words and phrases, and how well you know them.
strings.control.speak.text: Speak into the microphone. Let go when you are done.
strings.control.typeline.keys: W or Tab in a conversation
strings.control.typeline.text: Type your answer instead. Enter sends it.
strings.control.help.text: Help: shows the English and the phrase to say.
strings.control.noidea.text: “No sé” means I don't know. It is never wrong.
strings.control.replay.keys: R and S in a conversation
strings.control.replay.text: Hear the last line again, or more slowly.
strings.control.lessonKeys.keys: Enter, K, L during a lesson
strings.control.lessonKeys.text: Enter: continue. K: skip this step. L: start the lesson at the guide.
strings.control.view.text: Switch between your own eyes and a view over your shoulder.
strings.control.sleep.keys: {key:talk} at a bed or a lit fire
strings.control.sleep.text: Sleep until morning and start the next session, once this session's work is done.
strings.control.report.text: Report a bug or ask for a feature. A Markdown file and a screenshot go to the session folder. Ctrl+Enter saves, Esc cancels.
strings.control.escape.text: Open the menu, or close what is open.
